userId.description: The owning user account id; null when the principal carries none.

subjectId.description: The subject permissions are computed for (user id or api key id).

email.description: Email claim when the session is a user cookie.

displayName.description: Display-name claim (user name, or the api key's label).

roles.description: Keys of the active role assignments, distinct and ordered.

description:
The authenticated caller's identity for SPA session bootstrap:
who the principal resolves to, the roles it holds, and the
effective permission sets per scope. Permissions are computed for
the request's subject — an API-key request reports the key's
assignments, not its owner's.
